This is a message from Volunteer Energy Cooperative. Please be advised that a planned power outage will occur in your area on Thursday, November 19, beginning at 12:00 PM and lasting until approximately 4:00 PM.
This outage is necessary to allow crews to safely complete multi-phase upgrades in the area. Some members may experience only a brief interruption at the beginning and end of the outage while switching is performed, while most affected members will remain without power for the duration of the work.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience and understanding while these necessary upgrades are completed. Thank you.
